evaluateImgLists: evaluate Cityscapes instance-level semantic labeling predictions against ground truth images and return computed metrics
matchGtWithPreds: match ground truth instances with prediction results for Cityscapes evaluation using IoU assignment
readGTImage: read a Cityscapes ground truth image from local path or remote file backend and return numpy array
readPredInfo: read and parse a Cityscapes prediction text file into a dictionary of label IDs and confidence scores
getGtInstances: load or create ground truth instances dictionary from JSON cache or PNG label files for Cityscapes evaluation
instances2dict: parse Cityscapes instance label images into a dictionary of per-label instance objects with bounding box data
